name: Balanced, in a weak market
notes: RSI(14) under 35 is real weakness, not just a soft week, so this buys a moderately larger cover over a moderate window -- the same size and length a conservative holder keeps on hand even in a calm market, which is intended, not a coincidence.
summary: More cover than usual, held a little longer.

name: Balanced, in a calm market
notes: RSI(14) over 35 is an ordinary market, so this holds a smaller, shorter cover rather than none -- one day, the shortest window balanced ever holds. An RSI reading of exactly 35 matches neither band -- a known, accepted gap, not a bug.
